export interface AsamI18n {
    readonly locale: ComputedRef<string>;
    readonly requestedLocale: ComputedRef<string>;
    readonly nativeLocale: ComputedRef<AsamNativeLocale | undefined>;
    readonly issues: ComputedRef<readonly AsamI18nIssue[]>;
    t(...args: AsamI18nCall): string;
    dispose(): void;
}

type EpPropFinalized<Type, Value, Validator, Default, Required> = EpProp<EpPropMergeType<Type, Value, Validator>, UnknownToNever<Default>, Required>;

ts
type EpProp<Type, Default, Required> = {
  readonly type: PropType<Type>;
  readonly required: [Required] extends [true] ? true : false;
  readonly validator: ((val: unknown) => boolean) | undefined;
  [epPropKey]: true;
} & IfNever<Default, unknown, {
  readonly default: Default;
}>;
